name: OpenDrawer
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS 3.5 or later and a running Workbench
notes: Juergen Reinert's Blitz BASIC command identifies as OpenDrawer 0.1 (13 November 1999) and matches the pinned Aminet member.
The installed Directory Opus configuration invokes C:Opendrawer with the selected source drawer. That configuration stays with Directory Opus.
